ayahs.en: When the sky has split [open]

ayahs.tl: Wa azinat li Rabbihaa wa huqqat
ayahs.en: And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]
And when the earth has been extended

ayahs.tl: Wa alqat maa feehaa wa takhallat
ayahs.en: And has cast out that within it and relinquished [it]

ayahs.tl: Wa azinat li Rabbihaa wa huqqat
ayahs.en: And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so] -

ayahs.ar: يٰ٘اَيُّهَا الۡاِنۡسَانُ اِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ اِلٰي رَبِّكَ كَدۡحًا فَمُلٰقِيۡهِۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Yaaa ayyuhal insaanu innaka kaadihun ilaa Rabbika kad han famulaaqeeh
ayahs.en: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion and will meet it.

ayahs.tl: Fa ammaa man ootiya kitaabahoo biyameenih
ayahs.en: Then as for he who is given his record in his right hand,
He will be judged with an easy account
And return to his people in happiness.

ayahs.ar: وَاَمَّا مَنۡ اُوۡتِيَ كِتٰبَهٗ وَرَآءَ ظَهۡرِهٖۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa ammaa man ootiya kitaabahoo waraaa'a zahrih
ayahs.en: But as for he who is given his record behind his back,
He will cry out for destruction
And [enter to] burn in a Blaze.
Indeed, he had [once] been among his people in happiness;
Indeed, he had thought he would never return [to Allah].

ayahs.ar: بَلٰ٘يۚۛ اِنَّ رَبَّهٗ كَانَ بِهٖ بَصِيۡرًاؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Balaaa inna Rabbahoo kaana bihee baseeraa
ayahs.en: But yes! Indeed, his Lord was ever of him, Seeing.
So I swear by the twilight glow
And [by] the night and what it envelops
And [by] the moon when it becomes full
[That] you will surely experience state after state.
So what is [the matter] with them [that] they do not believe,

ayahs.ar: وَاِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيۡهِمُ الۡقُرۡاٰنُ لَا يَسۡجُدُوۡنَࣛؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa izaa quri'a 'alaihimul Quraanu laa yasjudoon
ayahs.en: And when the Qur'an is recited to them, they do not prostrate [to Allah]?
But those who have disbelieved deny,
And Allah is most knowing of what they keep within themselves.
So give them tidings of a painful punishment,

ayahs.ar: اِلَّا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ لَهُمۡ اَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُوۡنٍࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Illal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati lahum ajrun ghairu mamnoon
ayahs.en: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted.
